from collections import defaultdict
import json

# Obtener la respuesta del nodo anterior
items = _input.all()
data = items[0].json

# Mapear columnas a sus índices para convertir las filas a dicts
table = data['tables'][0]
columns = [col['name'] for col in table['columns']]
rows = table['rows']

errors = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in rows]

if not errors:
    return [{"json": {"skip": True, "message": "No hay errores en los últimos 15 minutos"}}]

# Agrupar por cloud_RoleInstance y tipo de error (ya vienen ordenados por la KQL)
grouped = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
for error in errors:
    instance = error.get('cloud_RoleInstance') or 'Unknown'
    error_type = error.get('type') or 'Unknown'
    grouped[instance][error_type].append(error)

total_errors = len(errors)

# ── Teams (MessageCard legacy, compatible con webhooks simples) ──────────────
def build_teams_payload(grouped, total):
    sections = []
    for instance in sorted(grouped):
        for error_type in sorted(grouped[instance]):
            errs = grouped[instance][error_type]
            first = errs[0]
            short_type = error_type.split('.')[-1]
            message = (first.get('innermostMessage') or
                       first.get('outerMessage') or
                       first.get('message') or 'Sin mensaje')
            sections.append({
                "activityTitle": f"🔴 [{instance}] {short_type} — {len(errs)} ocurrencia(s)",
                "activitySubtitle": f"Instancia: `{instance}` | Servicio: `{first.get('cloud_RoleName', '-')}`",
                "activityText": message[:300],
                "facts": [
                    {"name": "Tipo completo", "value": error_type},
                    {"name": "Operación",     "value": first.get('operation_Name', '-')},
                    {"name": "Último visto",  "value": first.get('timestamp', '-')},
                ]
            })
    return {
        "@type": "MessageCard",
        "@context": "http://schema.org/extensions",
        "themeColor": "FF0000",
        "summary": f"{total} errores detectados",
        "title": f"⚠️ {total} errores en los últimos 15 min — Application Insights",
        "sections": sections
    }

# ── Discord (Webhook con embeds) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def build_discord_payload(grouped, total):
    embeds = []
    for instance in sorted(grouped):
        for error_type in sorted(grouped[instance]):
            errs = grouped[instance][error_type]
            first = errs[0]
            short_type = error_type.split('.')[-1]
            message = (first.get('innermostMessage') or
                       first.get('outerMessage') or
                       first.get('message') or 'Sin mensaje')
            embeds.append({
                "title": f"🔴 [{instance}] {short_type} × {len(errs)}",
                "description": message[:300],
                "color": 15158332,  # Rojo
                "fields": [
                    {"name": "Instancia",      "value": instance,                            "inline": True},
                    {"name": "Servicio",        "value": first.get('cloud_RoleName', '-'),   "inline": True},
                    {"name": "Operación",       "value": first.get('operation_Name', '-'),   "inline": False},
                    {"name": "Tipo completo",   "value": f"`{error_type}`",                  "inline": False},
                    {"name": "Último registro", "value": first.get('timestamp', '-'),        "inline": False},
                ],
                "footer": {"text": "Application Insights Alert"}
            })
    return {
        "username": "Application Insights",
        "avatar_url": "https://azure.microsoft.com/svghandler/application-insights/",
        "content": f"⚠️ **{total} errores detectados en los últimos 15 minutos**",
        "embeds": embeds[:10]  # Discord permite máximo 10 embeds por mensaje
    }

teams_payload   = build_teams_payload(grouped, total_errors)
discord_payload = build_discord_payload(grouped, total_errors)

return [{
    "json": {
        "teams":       teams_payload,
        "discord":     discord_payload,
        "error_count": total_errors,
        "skip":        False
    }
}]
